description: Makes a picture the owner sent one of the business's own pictures (Create's library, which later pictures and films pick from; read for the brand's look on the owner's tokens, as every picture they add is) and gives its file id for what you make. Use it only when the owner says the picture is theirs to keep, or asks for it in something you make; never for a picture of someone else's they sent to talk about. It needs an act key.

id.description: the picture's id, from input.attached or attachment_read

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
